purpose: Supplement to fresh full-domain current barrier checks. This records the first-exit enclosure used by the original task verifier; no tasks.py modification.
arithmetic: float64 evaluation of explicit inequalities; no directed rounding

lane.argument: Any first discrete-time exit from the safe rectangle lies in the four audited unsafe strips inside [-1.3,1.3]^2. Initial B<=1, unsafe strips B>=20 and nonincrease over the safe B<20 sublevel exclude such a first exit.

aebs.argument: The unabsorbed step from d>6,v>1e-6 remains in d>=5.85,d<=16,v in [0,3]. A dangerous first crossing is in the audited [5,6]x[.5,3] rectangle. Success, dangerous states and a safe zero-speed stop are then absorbing. No drift after absorption is required.
